Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. The Safety Specialist supports training and implementation for all aspects of safety for office locations and active construction sites. This position will need to implement policies as required; maintain official training materials, document files, and maintain company equipment/property. Other duties include assisting with training all employees, implementation/interpretation of safety programs, jobsite audits and inspections, construction management support, QA/QC support, and project management support. COMPETENCIES: Customer Focus Decision Quality Business Insight Drives Results Collaborates Communicates Effectively Courage Instills Trust Manages Ambiguity ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Supports safety oversight on all offices and construction projects. Carries out training and implementation of Beta's Safety, Health and Environmental Program (SHEP) and federal and state OSHA regulations. Performs safety audits at all office locations and all project site locations to document compliance. Provide input on projected staffing safety training needs to meet future and active project requirements. Supports revisions to Beta’s SHEP. Compiles prequalification of subcontractor’s safety programs and safety performance. Responsible for maintaining Beta Man-hour dashboard. Provides evaluation of office and project safety needs, such as communications, office materials, job specific requirements, etc. Create job specific safety requirements and provide site specific safety programs where required by the project specifications. Provides increased support for projects with subcontractor safety issues. Supports site safety to either project manager or construction manager to address site specific construction issues and bring resolution by either increased site presence or remote support from the office. Provides safety supervision on specialized equipment installations. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Three or more years of safety role supporting high voltage construction related experience or Bachelor’s Degree in related field with additional experience. Must be knowledgeable of safety aspects for general civil, structural, mechanical and electrical industries. Must have knowledge of OSHA construction regulations. Experience using Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Adobe Acrobat, and Microsoft Project COSS or equivalent certification Note to Candidates:This is an evergreen job posting. By submitting your application, you will be considered for future vacancies. We actively review submissions and will reach out when a matching role becomes available!

titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:ba8fed64-e209.title: Sourcing Analyst
titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:ba8fed64-e209.description: SOURCING ANALYST About Titan Titan is an AI holding company transforming IT services with its Augmented AI platform. We acquire and partner with the best Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and embed AI at the core of their operations, empowering technicians to work faster, smarter, and more strategically. Our augmented AI platform enables MSPs to scale like technology companies while delivering faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support for their customers. In under a year, we’ve raised over $70M from General Catalyst, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and deployed agents seeing real-world impact to productivity. Our team bring together AI product expertise from Scale AI, Google, MIT, and Stanford with private equity experience from H.I.G. Capital and seasoned MSP executives who have led some of the industry’s top providers. Joining Titan means helping to redefine how work is done in IT Services and building a $100B company. About the Role We’re looking for a Sourcing Analyst to fuel Titan’s acquisition engine by building and managing a high-quality pipeline of potential MSP targets. You’ll be responsible for mapping markets, identifying and qualifying acquisition opportunities, and engaging with owners to start the conversation. This role is foundational to our growth strategy and offers direct exposure to the M&A team, leadership, and investors. What You’ll Do - Research and map the MSP and IT services market to identify acquisition targets. - Build, manage, and maintain Titan’s deal sourcing pipeline and CRM. - Conduct company-level analysis on size, service offerings, location, and financial potential. - Initiate contact with potential targets via email, phone, and networking channels. - Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, market position, and deal feasibility. - Support M&A Associate and leadership with market intel and target lists. - Track outreach metrics, deal progression, and conversion rates. Who You Are - 3+ years of experience in business development, sourcing, investment banking, private equity, or lead generation. - Strong research skills and ability to synthesize market and company data into actionable insights. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable initiating cold outreach. - Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple sourcing campaigns simultaneously. - Self-starter with a proactive mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. - Bonus: experience in IT services, SaaS, or acquisition-driven growth environments.
